title: Creamy Broccoli Pasta
subtitle: with Parmesan and Parsley
description: Whether you’re full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they’re packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they’re totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Cook spaghetti: Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to the boil. Add three-quarters of the spaghetti (see Did you know?) and cook for 12 mins or until al dente. Reserve 60ml (¼ cup) cooking water, then drain the spaghetti.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, finely chop the onion. Cut the broccoli stem into 1cm chunks, then cut the head into small florets. Pick the parsley leaves and finely chop the stems. Finely grate the parmesan.

Cook onion and broccoli: Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the onion, stirring, for 3-4 mins until softened. Add the broccoli and parsley stems and cook, stirring, for 1-2 mins until just starting to become tender.

Thicken sauce: Add the cream, reserved cooking water and 3 tsp pepper and garlic seasoning to the broccoli and stir to combine. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins or until thickened.

Serve up: Add the spaghetti and parmesan to the sauce and toss to combine. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the creamy broccoli pasta among bowls and scatter over the parsley leaves. Enjoy!

Did you know?: Wondering why we only suggest using three-quarters of the spaghetti? All our recipes are approved by our nutritionist who is guided by the Australian Guide to Healthy Eating, ensuring you get a meal that's both nutritious and delicious! This recipe makes the perfect portion of sauce for this amount of spaghetti.
